description: National Hydropower Plant Dataset, Version 2 (FY18Q3) is a data set deposited in DOE Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL) Repository by its authors Nicole Samu, Shih-Chieh Kao. The National Hydropower Plant Dataset, Version 2 (FY18Q3) is a point-level dataset with full geographic coverage containing locations and key characteristics of U.S. hydropower plants that are currently either in the hydropower development pipeline (pre-operational), operational, withdrawn, or retired. These data are provided in GIS and tabular formats with corresponding metadata for each. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2018. The repository holds 2 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
